title: Auto-(de)phosphorylation assay
author: Sarah van Veen
materials: Aspirate supernatant with pipet, keep in disposable recipient.
Expose gel Overnight to phosphoimager cassette.

steps.title: Prepare gel solutions
steps.instruction: Mix the following components immediately before casting: Running gel – 30% acrylamide/bis‑acrylamide 10 mL, H₂O 24.6 mL, TEMED 30 µL, APS 10 % 300 µL, SDS 10 % 400 µL, Running‑gel buffer 5 mL. Stacking gel – 30% acrylamide/bis‑acrylamide 1.6 mL, H₂O 8.52 mL, TEMED 19.2 µL, APS 10 % 200 µL, SDS 10 % 120 µL, Stacking‑gel buffer 1.52 mL.

steps.title: Pour running gel
steps.instruction: Assemble glass plates with spacers, pour the running‑gel mixture into the gap, and allow it to polymerize.

steps.title: Overlay with butanol
steps.instruction: Add butanol on top of the running gel, wait until the gel solidifies, then wash the butanol off with water.

steps.title: Pour stacking gel and insert comb
steps.instruction: Pour the stacking‑gel mixture on top of the solidified running gel and insert a suitable comb.

steps.title: Store solidified stacking gel
steps.instruction: After the stacking gel has polymerized, store the gel plates at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare protein samples
steps.instruction: Combine either membranes containing 40 µg protein or purified protein (1 µg) with 10 µL 10× EP buffer, milli‑Q water, and the test compound to a final volume of 95 µL; keep samples on ice.

steps.title: Prepare radioactive ATP mix
steps.instruction: Pipette 5 µL [γ‑³²P] ATP (2 µCi, 5.125 µM) together with 110.5 µL 120 µM cold ATP to obtain a radioactive ATP mix of 2 µCi (5.125 µM).

steps.title: Initiate phosphorylation reaction
steps.instruction: Add 5 µL radioactive ATP mix to each sample and vortex briefly.

steps.title: Terminate phosphorylation (optional)
steps.instruction: After the desired incubation time, add 400 µL stop solution to each reaction.

steps.title: Precipitate proteins on ice
steps.instruction: Leave the samples on ice for 30 minutes to precipitate the protein.

steps.title: Centrifuge and wash pellet
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 20 000 × g, 4 °C for 10 minutes; discard supernatant, wash the pellet with 400 µL stop solution, and centrifuge again under the same conditions.

steps.title: Repeat precipitation and wash
steps.instruction: Repeat the ice precipitation (30 min) and the centrifuge‑wash step once more.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet in sample buffer
steps.instruction: Dissolve the washed pellet in 40 µL sample buffer.

steps.title: Load samples onto acidic gel
steps.instruction: Load 40 µL of each resuspended sample onto an acidic SDS‑PAGE gel, taking care to avoid overflow between wells.

steps.title: Run electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Run the gel at 100 V, 4 °C for 4 hours.

steps.title: Remove dye front
steps.instruction: When the run is complete, carefully cut off the blue dye front (excess ³²P that runs ahead of the samples).

steps.title: Acidic post‑fixation
steps.instruction: Soak the gel for 5 minutes in 7.5 % acetic acid, then place the gel in a plastic bag.

steps.title: Image phosphor screen
steps.instruction: Place the gel cassette in a phosphor imager (e.g., Typhoon FLA 7000, GE Healthcare) and acquire the image.

steps.title: Check loading with Coomassie
steps.instruction: Soak the gel overnight in Coomassie stain, wash, and evaluate staining intensity to verify equal sample loading.

steps.title: Dephosphorylation assay (alternative)
steps.instruction: Thirty seconds after adding [γ‑³²P] ATP, add the test compound (e.g., non‑radioactive ATP, ADP, polyamines) and stop the reaction with 400 µL stop solution after the desired time.

steps.title: Hydroxylamine wash (optional)
steps.instruction: Wash the pellet with 200 µL 0.3 M hydroxylamine, incubate 15 minutes, then centrifuge at 20 000 × g, 4 °C for 10 minutes.
